author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
What's the line between "taking your job seriously" and "taking care of yourself"? Has Adam Savage ever found himself in a situation where he needed to act as manager but wasn't actually a manager? Has a coworker ever taken credit for Adam's ideas? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members Ziz62266, joshuaschisser2967 and clivebravejones9516, whom we thank for their support! Do you have any difficult-coworker stories?
